title: Craftable Uncraftables And More!
description: This mod adds all the uncraftable thing to minecraft and a few extra things.
body:
This mod adds all the uncraftable thing to minecraft and a few extra things.

The things that are now craftable ~
- Enchanted Golden Apple
- Trident
- Elytra
- Nehterite tools and armor (Made the same way as any other armor, no netherite hoe)
- Command Block
- Bedrock
- NameTag
- Totem Of Undying
- Saddle and all horse armor
- Nether Star
- Chainmail armor (Made the same as any other armor)
- Crying Obsidian
- Heart Of The Sea
- End Portal Frame 
- Mineing Enchantment (still in delelopment)


  ![All Of the Crafting Recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e31d5a03d7ca8e1ef0651e93d687c9a8629fd1b8.png)


New Advacment can be Unlocked by Crafting all of the recipes
